title: 2008 HMMT February Team Round 2 Problem 9
statement: Show that the converse of the previous statement is false by providing a non-juggling sequence \(j(0) j(1) j(2)\) of length 3 where the average \(\frac{1}{3}(j(0)+j(1)+j(2))\) is an integer. Show that your example works.

solutions.text:
One such example is 210 . This is not a juggling sequence since \(f(0)=f(1)=2\).
